title: Reddit pages to read offline
body: Save a loaded page for offline reading, and keep a private draft for that page. Saved pages are read-only and separate for each sign-in. Votes and posting still require a connection. Snapshots include only loaded content and do not download streaming videos.

title: A fresh catch, every update
body: Anglerfish now shows version-specific release notes after an update.

title: Available offline
body: Reopen these notes from Settings without downloading anything.
